title: The Goldfinch
author: Donna Tartt
summary: A thirteen-year-old survives a bombing at an art museum that kills his mother, and leaves with a small Dutch painting. He carries it, and his grief, through a chaotic youth in New York and Las Vegas into adulthood.
readIf: you want a big, immersive, Dickens-style novel about loss, art and a boy who grows up too fast.
skipIf: you dislike long novels that digress or characters who make poor choices.

pairings.reason: Another long, absorbing novel about trauma and friendship, though far harsher.
The classic model for an orphaned boy, a mysterious fortune and a life shaped by one early encounter.
Same author, with a tighter plot and a more menacing atmosphere.
